## Appraisals

Overall, students felt that the professor's teaching style did not align with effective communication and active learning strategies, detracting from the overall quality of the course experience.

## Appraisals
Students appreciate that various components of the evaluation process, including tests, assessments, exams, and sessions, are functioning well. ## Criticisms
Students expressed dissatisfaction with evaluations that were perceived as overly lengthy and disconnected from classroom instruction. They felt that tests and exams were extended and sometimes included extraneous material, which they believed added unnecessary pressure and made them feel less prepared. Additionally, the timing of tests was criticized as inconvenient, particularly when other deadlines and exams were already in progress. Students also noted that the content of some tests did not align with the material covered in class, leading to confusion and frustration. There was a concern that the evaluation methods favored some students over others, potentially distorting the true assessment of students' understanding and skills.

They also recommend considering a policy update to alleviate the semester's overwhelming nature.
